commit_message: Fix AI Studio conversation lane clippy lint
pr_body:
## Summary

- Center the AI Studio header, transcript, and composer in a responsive 960px conversation lane on wide windows.
- Keep narrow windows full-width and reduce the composer draft from three rows to two.
- Use the idiomatic width clamp required by the lint gate.
- Preserve the existing approval, run-control, proposal, settings, and Agent Host governance behavior.

## Validation
